title: Self-Supervised Continuous-Time Depth Learning and Ego-Motion Estimation from Asynchronous Events
abstract: arXiv:2611.27509v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Event cameras register brightness changes pixel by pixel with microsecond precision, whereas the dense depth that could supervise them is costly to acquire and exists only at isolated instants. Condensing the stream into frames eases learning, but at the expense of the very timing that sets event sensing apart. We propose a self-supervised approach in which each event is assigned its own depth in continuous time, and the camera motion is recovered from the same observations. Supervision arises from geometry: lifted into 3D by its predicted depth and displaced by the camera motion at the instant it fired, an event should coincide with others produced by the same edge, so any misalignment exposes an error in depth or motion. Differentiable rendering then turns these per-event estimates into dense depth maps at target times within each window, faithful to the events behind them. On MVSEC, the approach outperforms prior event-only self-sup

translated_title: 基于异步事件的自监督连续时间深度学习与自运动估计
translated_abstract: 事件相机以微秒级精度逐像素地记录亮度变化，而可用于监督它们的稠密深度数据获取成本高昂，且仅存在于孤立的时刻。将事件流压缩成帧虽然便于学习，但代价是牺牲了事件感知赖以独特的高时间分辨率特性。我们提出了一种自监督方法，其中每个事件在连续时间中被赋予其自身的深度，同时相机运动也从相同的观测中恢复出来。监督信号源于几何：一个事件通过其预测深度被提升到三维空间，并经过它在触发瞬间的相机运动位移后，应当与由同一条边缘产生的其他事件相重合，因此任何错位都会暴露深度或运动估计中的误差。随后，可微渲染将这些逐事件的估计转化为每个窗口内目标时刻的稠密深度图，并忠实于其背后的事件。在MVSEC数据集上，该方法优于先前仅基于事件的自监督方法。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种自监督的连续时间深度学习方法，为每个异步事件分配独立深度并从同一观测中恢复相机自运动，利用事件间的几何一致性作为监督信号，并通过可微渲染生成目标时刻的稠密深度图，在MVSEC数据集上超越了先前仅基于事件的自监督方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a self-supervised continuous-time depth learning approach that assigns each asynchronous event its own depth and recovers camera ego-motion from the same observations, using geometric consistency across events as supervision and differentiable rendering to produce dense depth maps, outperforming prior event-only self-supervised methods on MVSEC.
